scope: Manual source comparison of27 original test cases plus their shared helpers; AST-extracted direct expect sites aid review, not behavioral proof or an assertion execution count.

shared.native: opt-in log.entryAdded journal retained across documents plus early error/rejection preload
shared.qualification: negative-control case distinguishes info/console error/uncaught JS and verifies errors survive navigation; no future asynchronous or spoken-output claim

shared.native: workflowReadiness and authoredReady; first-paint isolated/early/no-js checks
shared.qualification: authored children eager except exact dormant settings palette; enhanced and no-JS scene/nav/link/current/reset/source checks; held-module navigation/current-link checks observe DOM only because native AX lookup waits for document readiness. Selection readiness deliberately uses registry-aware stronger helper.

shared.native: native named controls, pointer/key actions, captured values, exact active descendant and collapsed choice
shared.qualification: BiDi native actions replace Playwright fill/selectOption; direct DOM scripting limited to focus/selection, state observation, reconnect and original form requestSubmit.

shared.native: JSON identities, axe files and selected geometry; no native screenshots
shared.qualification: functional source comparison does not adopt VRT or establish visual review.

limitations: No full native AX, spoken output, physical IME/device or cross-OS qualification.
Native source comparison is not equivalence of every protocol action or timing. Explicit input and fixture-grouping adaptations are retained.
The two SSO descriptions and one Selection description, pre-upgrade computed labels and computed status roles need separate platform evidence. Original Playwright checks remain intact.
Original screenshot candidates and incomplete contrast findings remain review obligations.
Fresh native receipt must bind these sources; this map alone records a review, never a browser pass.
